verdicts.rationale: REST API accepts malformed filter structure where must_not should be array of Condition objects but single inline Condition object is accepted. Source code shows Filter derives Validate with #[validate(nested)] but REST layer never invokes validation. MaybeOneOrMany deserialization helper silently converts single object to array, masking schema violation before validation opportunity. This is a genuine validation gap, not by-design leniency - no evidence in code/comments that accepting malformed format is intentional. Contract explicitly defines must_not as Option<Vec<Condition>>, and physical type system requires array. API violates both.
